node.title: Rate-half MCA codeword-direction gauge rank router
node.closure: field-general equivalence and exact deployed rank walls
node.statement: Subtracting any codeword b from the received-line direction and gamma b from each slope explanation preserves slopes, exact agreement supports, and same-support pair noncontainment. The original and transformed explanation affine ranks differ by at most one. Applying the support-wise affine-span compiler in row (R+K,K,d+K) gives an exact two-term bound whose deployed ambient-dimension walls are: KoalaBear ranks <=11 at all K, rank 12 through K=745260, rank 13 through K=289603; Mersenne ranks <=4 at all K and rank 5 through K=482472.
